title: Binance Resumes Withdrawals After $6.3 Billion Security Breach
excerpt: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance has restored withdrawal services after a major breach resulted in the theft of $6.3 billion in assets.
body_html:
Cryptocurrency exchange Binance has officially restored withdrawal services following a massive security breach. The incident involved the theft of $6.3 billion in assets from the platform.

According to the company, recovery efforts are underway, with the exchange stating that it has successfully covered 95% of the stolen assets so far. Normal operational services, including withdrawals, are now resuming for users.
